title: Monthly client report
description: At the start of each month, sum up last month per client for the owner: meetings and hours from the calendar, emails exchanged, and what was invoiced

settings.CLIENTS: client names for domains or addresses, like {"acme.com": "Acme"}; others are named after their domain
settings.SKIP: addresses or domains that aren't clients (colleagues, suppliers)
settings.MIN_MEETINGS: meetings in the month before someone counts as a client (when nothing was invoiced)
